description: For a sign-in page, retrieve a username/password credential only if the current browser host is allowed for login, then seal requested fields into session slots. Raw values are never returned; use operate_type with slot with the returned slot names to fill the page.

fields.description: Exact field_names from list_credentials for the selected reference. Defaults to ["login","password"] for logins saved by operate_login; use ["username","password"] when those are the stored names. Use operate_type with each returned slot to fill its matching form control.

name: operate_fill_credential
